messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

['UPON RECEIPT OF YOUR REPLY, I WILL SEND TO YOU BY FAX OR EMAIL THE TEXT OF THE APPLICATION.', 'I look forward to receiving your email.', 'please as soon as you receive thisproposalplease try and get me back immediately.']
